title: Clients see how their request got to them
description: The approval page and the approval email now show a progress timeline, so the client can see when the work was done and who did and checked it before they review it.
items: Request submitted, accepted, work started, work finished with the person in charge, and checked by QA with the reviewer's name
The page ends with the client's own step and the date to respond by
Only names and dates are shown. Team comments, including the QA comment, stay internal
pending: Needs the P16-09 database update applied before the timeline appears.
